_name: Error — the on-mount Promise.all rejected at the .then/.catch boundary; renders <div class='cpage-error'> with clientsPage.loadError. UNSTYLED in source (no rule in static/*.css) — FLAG.
_note: Each individual fetch is .catch-guarded to a benign empty, so this branch only fires if the outer .then itself throws (e.g. setS or a render-time exception). Drive in isolate via the error signal directly. The rendered text is the literal tFor(lang,'clientsPage.loadError',{error}) string.
